thread:
Nora: FYI AcmeCorp flagged a ~11% higher final invoice than their dashboard for EOM. Looks like an 'auxiliary plan' line was billed; dashboard shows nothing for that bucket. BillingBot posted the invoice at 10:02.
Jorge: Can you drop the account id? I'll query ledger.
Nora: acct_acme_1234 — they attached the invoice PDF. They say invoice total > dashboard by 1,922 tokens (not currency) and they did not change plan tier.
Jorge: running a quick ledger vs dashboard rollup for the EOM window...
BillingBot: Invoice generated for acct_acme_1234 (invoice_2026_01_31_001).
Ari: :eyes: could be a late backfill or an auxiliary-add-on write. Did we run any embed backfills or retries around 00:10-00:20 UTC on 2026-01-31?
Jorge: I see a background embed job retry loop around 00:14 (PID 2248). Pasting the SQL I'm running to compare: 
```
SELECT sum(tokens) as invoiced_tokens FROM billing.ledger WHERE acct='acct_acme_1234' AND ts >= '2026-01-31' AND ts < '2026-02-01' AND source='auxiliary_plan';
```
Nora: Dashboard query `dashboard.tokens_by_account('acct_acme_1234','2026-01-31')` returns 17,422.
Jorge: Ledger sum returns 19,344 => delta 1,922 tokens. Rows show source='auxiliary_plan' and reason='embed_retry_backfill'.
Noura (billing): That source is written by the embed-service when a retry succeeds after the cutoff — those should be flagged as off-cycle so they are excluded from billing. Looks like the `billing_class` meta wasn't set on retry writes.
Nora: Can we repro and patch? Customer is asking for a credit/refund for that specific line.
Ari: Assign to @eng-billing to confirm if `is_off_cycle`/`billing_class` flag was omitted during retry path.
Sam (eng-billing): Picking this up. I can repro locally: embed-service retry path writes ledger entries without `meta.billing_class`. Repro steps I'm using: 1) run embed backfill with simulated transient failure, 2) let retry succeed after cutoff, 3) inspect ledger rows. Minimal fix is to default retry-origin writes to `billing_class='offcycle'` when meta is missing.
Jorge: I tested a local patch and it repros the bug; applying the default fixes the classification.
Sam: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/472 — adds \"billing_class\": \"offcycle\" to retry path and unit tests. Rolling this to staging now.
Nora: What about existing invoices/customers affected? Can we reclass those ledger rows and issue credits?
Noura (billing): Yes — we can run a migration to reclass rows where source='auxiliary_plan' AND reason='embed_retry_backfill' AND invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND billed=true to set billed=false and create a matching credit transaction. I'll author the migration runbook and estimate totals.
Nora: Customer wants ETA and a partial credit now if possible.
Sam: For immediate remediation we can insert a negative invoice line equal to the token delta (quick credit) and mark it as customer credit; then follow-up with the migration to repair ledger rows. This requires finance approval.
Ari: Tagging @Lina from finance for emergency approval.
Lina (finance): Reviewing — need invoice id, exact USD amount and GL code. Nora please attach invoice_2026_01_31_001 and the exported ledger rows for the delta.
Nora: Attached CSV and invoice link: https://invoices.redwood/acme/invoice_2026_01_31_001.pdf
Lina (finance): OK — approve emergency credit up to $45. Finance code CR-EMB-01. Please include note for reversal if migration changes amount.
Sam: Staging deploy done, tests green. Migration script prepared: mscripts/2026/388_reclass_embedded_backfills.sql. Dry-run scheduled 2026-02-02T02:00Z, prod run 2026-02-02T05:00Z pending finance.
Nora: I'll reply to the customer with plan: immediate credit now + follow-up migration + postmortem after root cause fixed. :thumbsup:
Ari: Please add a short incident note to #incidents and ping here when migration is scheduled.
Nora: Will do. TICKET-4982 opened and linked to INC-2026-045.
Sam (eng-billing): Follow-ups logged: PR 472, migration script mscripts/2026/388_reclass_embedded_backfills.sql, dry-run 2026-02-02T02:00Z, prod run 2026-02-02T05:00Z (pending finance).
